items.prompt: What happens to an identical repeated execution ID/payload in this capstone?

options.text: It is applied again as a second fill
options.why: That double-counts an explicitly repeated event.

options.text: It is overwritten with a newly guessed price
options.why: Original evidence must not be silently changed.

options.text: It is a counted no-op under the declared duplicate policy
options.why: This policy is local to the specified immutable-execution namespace.

options.text: It proves every broker uses this correction rule

items.explanation: The same complete batch can be replayed without changing economic state under this explicit model.
